# Public contract fixtures

The JSON fixtures are copied (with trailing blank lines normalized) from the Wulkanowy SDK test suite:
https://github.com/wulkanowy/sdk/tree/master/sdk-scrapper/src/test/resources/io/github/wulkanowy/sdk/scrapper

They contain public test data, not data from the user's school account.
Wulkanowy SDK is licensed under Apache 2.0; its license is included in this directory.
The GPE adapter is independently implemented and also checked against the current
GPE frontend's MVC request contracts.
